messages:
Ellen (Content): Pushing a fresh launch blog draft for final copy + routing checks: https://notion.so/redwood/launch-blog-v5-draft

Marco (Growth): Quick read  nice pacing. Two operational asks: separate CTAs (Start trial vs Request enterprise demo) and add hidden field `deal_size_band` on demo form so SDRs can triage.

Zoe (Design): Heads up: fig-2 alt missing. Suggest alt text: 'Throughput (tokens/sec) and median latency (ms) by sequence length'. Also can we have a tiny benchmark summary card that floats under the hero for mobile?

Riley (Sales Ops): Routing plan: demo form -> Sales Queue North; trial form -> auto-provision trial tenant. Hidden demo fields: deal_size_band, primary_vertical, timezone_region. I'll paste the exact HubSpot IDs into the shared sheet in ~10m. SLA: enterprise leads must be contacted within 24 business hours.

Nora (Legal): Flag: phrase "half the cost per token" is too specific. Please change to "lower per-token costs observed in our internal tests" and add a footnote referencing the internal cost appendix. Also ensure any customer quote has written approval.

Ellen (Content): Will soften the cost phrasing, add the footnote, and move the benchmark callout above the fold per Zoe. Also inserting a 2-line webinar teaser under CTAs: date + why attend.

devrel-bot: Recommend adding a short reproducer in the appendix with exact hardware + command so readers can reproduce: repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench-examples; command: `python run_bench.py --model redwood-3b --device a100-sxm-80g --batch 12 --seq 1024 --runs 6`

Marco (Growth): Webinar teaser draft: "Jul 22, 2024  live launch webinar: benchmark deep-dive + production rollout patterns. Register: https://events.redwood.ai/jul22" Add a sentence about a short Q&A and downloadable rollout playbook.

Zoe (Design): I'll add alt text and produce the floating benchmark card + a social share SVG. Requesting the hero shortened to one sentence.

Riley (Sales Ops): HubSpot embed snippet (paste into blog):
```
// hubspot embed example
const hubspotConfig = {
  formId: "form_trial_live" || "form_demo_enterprise",
  hiddenFields: {
    utm_source: "launch_blog",
    utm_medium: "blog",
    utm_campaign: "summer_launch_24",
    deal_size_band: "${deal_size_band}",
    primary_vertical: "${vertical}",
    timezone_region: "${tz_region}",
    product_area: "inference"
  }
};
```

Riley (Sales Ops): Also request a small SDR triage doc: what qualifies as an enterprise demo lead vs hand-off to growth (trial). I'll drop that in shared drive.

Nora (Legal): Also flag the small "comparison table" in the appendix: avoid direct competitor names unless we link to public benchmarks. Keep wording comparative but non-branded.

Ellen (Content): Noted. I'll remove competitor names and keep neutral phrasing. Adding footnote: "internal appendix for partners" until finance signs off.

devrel-bot: Suggest including a compact code snippet in appendix that shows the exact prompt + model args used, and a small CSV of raw run times so readers can eyeball variance.

Marco (Growth): GA/GTM tracking note: we need events for both CTA clicks and form_submits. Small suggestion: `dataLayer.push({event:'launch_cta', cta: btn.dataset.cta})` on click and a similar push on submit.

Ellen (Content): Can someone confirm webinar slot and whether we want a separate demo-only registration? If yes, we should route that form to Sales Queue North as well.

Riley (Sales Ops): Confirm separate demo-only reg -> Sales Queue North. Trial reg -> automated onboarding. I'll confirm assignment rules after I post the form IDs.

Zoe (Design): Final note: please keep hero copy < 140 chars for social preview. I'll proof the compressed hero when Ellen posts the update.

publish-bot: Checklist updated: awaiting sign-off from Legal and Sales Ops to enable enterprise routing. Target publish window: 2024-07-15T09:00:00-07:00 (PT). Webinar tentative: 2024-07-22T10:00:00-07:00 (PT). Final checklist runs 24h before publish. :hourglass:

Ellen (Content): I'll post an updated draft in ~35 minutes with (1) compressed hero, (2) benchmark callout above fold, (3) softened cost language + footnote, (4) alt text, (5) HubSpot embed snippet. If no objections by EOD tomorrow, we'll schedule the publish. Thanks all.

Marco (Growth): :thumbsup:

Riley (Sales Ops): will confirm HubSpot IDs today.

Nora (Legal): will review the softened phrasing and the quote approvals doc.

Ellen (Content): closing thread after update.
